about: Telegraph glows (fmWarnWhip and every *Warn* line/spot, mkWarnHand/mkWarnMouth, slagDrip): white-gold light each entity tints with visual.color. Replaces the tinted Fireball sheet.
name: Warn

glow.png.prompt: Paint a warning glow on the ground seen from the side: a flat wide ellipse of hot white-gold light lying on the ground with a blazing white core, little tongues of white flame flickering up from it and tiny sparks rising. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.

orb.png.prompt: Paint a round ball of hot white-gold light with a blazing white core, a soft round halo and a few tiny sparks and wisps of flame curling around it. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.

drip.png.prompt: Paint a fat glowing drop of molten white-gold light hanging from a thin glowing thread, about to fall, a soft halo and a few sparks. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.
